in_marathi.name: Bappa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Father of gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bappa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bappa is derived from the Marathi language and is the name of the god of child protection. In Hindu mythology, Bappa is also known as Ganesha, the elephant-headed god, who is revered as the remover of obstacles and the god of wisdom. Bappa is often invoked during the festival of Ganesh Chaturthi, when devotees bring a clay idol of the god into their homes and perform puja to seek his blessings for prosperity, wisdom, and good fortune.
